titleSuffix: Load, Not a Row at a Time

steps.label: No parallelism
steps.sub: A single INSERT is one serial leader-node operation

steps.label: No bulk path
steps.sub: Redshift storage is built for large columnar writes

steps.label: Wrong shape
steps.sub: The curated zone already holds whole Parquet files

steps.label: COPY fits
steps.sub: Loads S3 files in parallel, directly into the table

code:
COPY analytics.fact_orders (order_id, customer_id, product_sku,
  dt, region, quantity, unit_price, order_total)
FROM 's3://northfield-curated-zone/orders/'
IAM_ROLE 'arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/northfield-redshift-copy-role'
FORMAT AS PARQUET;
caption: Explicit column list, curated-zone source, Parquet format.

code:
-- S3 buckets have no username/password.
-- IAM_ROLE tells Redshift which role to ASSUME
-- for the duration of this load.
--
-- northfield-redshift-copy-role's policy currently
-- grants exactly the read access this COPY needs.
caption: The role is correctly scoped right now — remember its name.
